'''Sukkult''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Residing there was a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] collector of [[Tritonite]] documents. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.
